items.title: Decomp.dev shuts down: 'The community aspect of decompilation has been broken' by low-effort AI slop
items.excerpt: Developer Luke 'encounter' Street is closing decomp.dev, the site that tracked human-driven decompilations of classic games, citing the flood of low-effort AI decomps and ports.

items.title: Decomp.dev, a Massive Decompilation Community, Is Shutting Down After the Deluge of AI Game Decomps and Ports
items.excerpt: A month-long wave of people using AI to rapidly decompile, port and remix games has forced a major decompilation community, decomp.dev, to sunset.

items.title: Sega's Total War: Shogun 2 Remake Is Such A Disaster It's Being Pulled From Sale
items.excerpt: Sega and Creative Assembly pulled the AI-upscaled Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition from sale two days after launch following backlash over AI art and bugs, and restored the original 2011 version.

items.title: 이틀 만에 퇴각…'토탈 워: 쇼군2' 컴플리트 에디션 판매 중단
items.excerpt: 세가는 13일 출시한 '토탈 워: 쇼군2 - 컴플리트 에디션'을 버그와 AI 업스케일 아트 품질 논란으로 출시 이틀 만에 판매 중단하고 기존 2011년판 판매를 재개했다. 환불 기간 연장을 협의 중이다.

items.title: Battlefield 6 Gets Slammed For More Slop Slipping Through: 'Charging Players $$$ For AI-Generated Content Is Peak Disrespect'
items.excerpt: Paid Battlefield 6 operator cosmetics with five-fingered-gun artifacts and misspelled patches have players accusing EA of selling AI-generated content.

items.title: Accused of using AI in World of Warcraft: Forever videos, Blizzard employee says 'hell nah' - we have 'real team members'
items.excerpt: Blizzard's digital marketing manager says the studio does not use generative AI in any WoW: Forever social content after fans accused its ad videos of being AI-made.

items.title: After 8 years, Ultima creator says his MMO Shroud of the Avatar finally has 'zero bugs' thanks to AI
items.excerpt: Richard Garriott says AI bug-fixing cleared Shroud of the Avatar's backlog and that 'we need fewer people and less time to make it' because of AI.

items.title: Bluesky's AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
items.excerpt: Bluesky's Attie tool now generates small games and apps from prompts that can be shared on the social network; the CEO calls it 'vibe coding for your community.'

items.title: Interview: The Video Game Industry's Vibe-Coded Future
items.excerpt: Kotaku talks to Take-Two's former head of AI and Godot Engine's executive director about the 'Claude Opus-shaped problem' the game industry now faces.

items.title: 복원·패치·이식까지, AI 이용한 '게임 역분석' 주목
items.excerpt: AI 코딩 에이전트 발전으로 고전 게임 네이티브 포팅, 피처폰 명작 복원, 유저 번역 등에 AI 역분석이 확산되고 있지만 저작권·불법 복제 우려도 커지고 있다.

items.title: A First Look at Unreal MCP in Unreal Engine 5.8
items.excerpt: Epic's official first look at Unreal Model Context Protocol, an Epic-supported way to connect agentic LLM tools directly to the Unreal Editor so agents can act on projects.

items.title: [AGF 26] 서브컬처 행사 영상을 AI로? 팬덤 불만 폭발
items.excerpt: 국내 최대 서브컬처 행사 AGF가 올해 티저 영상을 생성형 AI로 만들어 AI에 반감이 큰 팬덤의 반발을 샀다.

items.title: [순정남] 진짜 같네! AI로 만든 '전세계 GTA' 영상 TOP 5
items.excerpt: GTA 6 출시를 앞두고 서울·도쿄 등 각국을 배경으로 AI 영상 생성으로 만든 가짜 인게임 패러디 영상이 유행하고 있다.

items.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark (ACE Nemotron 3.5 Bolt SLM in SkyrimNET, RTX Remix ComfyUI v2)
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's third-gen ACE game-character SLM, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, arrives Oct. 23 inside SkyrimNET's unscripted AI NPC mod, and RTX Remix 1.6 overhauls AI texture generation with ComfyUI v2.

items.title: Total War: Shogun 2's 'Enhanced' Version Removes Original, Is Buggy, Kneecaps Mod Support And Has Dogshit AI Art
items.excerpt: Aftermath details how Shogun 2's Complete Edition replaced the original with AI-upscaled art, broke mod support and shipped buggy, the backlash that preceded Sega pulling it from sale.
